Please watch carefully.
Jun 2022 • Couples
Tripadvisor please hire someone who refreshes the reviews. The last 4 places we went to that were "advised" on trip advisor either dissappeared or, due to some other reason, didnt serve what the reviews promissed us. 

The staff was extremely kind and tried helping us find food, but this place had to close their kitchen after COVID and we had to find out after driving 15 minutes. Not a big deal because we had a scooter, but its getting frustrating that we were misinformed again.

Maybe trip advisor should consider hiring someone to check if their reviews are still applicable to the reviewed places

Great friendly place with wonderfull food
Jan 2020
We were there in Jan 2020. went in for a coffee & returned later for an evening meal. The staff are very helpful, lovely surroundings, very clean & the food & coffee are wonderful. We ended up have 2 evening meals here & both were extremely good, would definitely add this to your list of lovely places to eat in Ha Long. 
We also asked the owner about a taxi back to Hanoi & he made a few calls & the price and service of the taxi were great, highly recommended.
